name: SmartStoreLabs AI Product Description Rewriter
author: smartstorelabs

sections.description:
SmartStoreLabs AI Product Description Rewriter turns thin product descriptions into structured, unique, SEO-friendly text with the OpenAI API.

What you get in this free plugin

  • One-click rewrite of a product description from the product edit screen, no usage limits
  • Editable prompts, model, creativity and minimum word count
  • You use your own OpenAI API key; the text is sent only to OpenAI

Pro (separate paid version from smartstorelabs.com)

The Pro version is a different download that contains additional code. It adds:

  • Translation of the new description into your other store languages, created and linked automatically with Polylang (price, stock, images, categories and variations included)
  • Bulk rewrite of the whole catalog
  • Backup of the previous description with one-click restore

The free plugin does not contain locked or disabled features and has no time or usage limits.

External services

This plugin sends data to third-party services.

OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com). When you press “Generate” or run a bulk rewrite, the product title, current description and attributes are sent to OpenAI with your own API key to produce the new text. Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Freemius (https://freemius.com). Handles licensing, updates and checkout for the Pro plan. Data is sent only after you opt in: site URL, WordPress and plugin versions, admin email. Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ , Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the zip from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Settings > AI Rewriter, paste your OpenAI API key (or define GPTRW_API_KEY in wp-config.php) and choose the model.
  4. Open any product and press “Generate AI description”.
sections.changelog:
3.3.5

  • Review fixes: every name now uses the gptrw_ prefix; backup, restore and translation code lives only in the Pro build; free description and readme made consistent.
  • API key: new constant GPTRW_API_KEY (the old GPT_REWRITER_API_KEY and the old stored key still work).

3.3.4

  • Fixes from the WordPress.org automated scan: escaping, wp_strip_all_tags, Tested up to 7.1.

3.3.3

  • Free version has no limits; translation, backup/restore and bulk rewrite are now Pro-only code that is not shipped in the free plugin.
  • Plugin renamed to SmartStoreLabs AI Product Description Rewriter.

3.3.2

  • Readme and header cleanup for the WordPress.org directory.

3.3.1

  • Freemius SDK 2.13.4.

3.3.0

  • Freemius licensing, Free and Pro plans.
